evidence.note: parseSseData writes done:true with the Option data default of none for [DONE], and done:false only with O.some(decoded). The chat stream drops done events and fails when a non-done event has data none.

notes: done (false|true) times data (none|some). Supported decoder states are terminal-without-payload and payload-not-terminal. Cardinality counts Option presence, not Unknown inhabitants.

evidence.note: parseSseData writes done:true with data omitted for [DONE], and done:false only together with the decoded data value. The chat stream skips done events and decodes event.data only on the other branch.

notes: done (false|true) times optional data (absent|present). Supported decoder states are terminal-without-data and data-not-terminal. Cardinality counts key presence, not Unknown inhabitants.

evidence.note: parseWebSocketMessage writes isBinary true with bytes and no text, or isBinary false with text and data and no bytes. Close and error events omit isBinary and bytes.

notes: Optional isBinary is absent|false|true, times bytes present|absent, times text present|absent. Supported frames are binary-with-bytes, text-with-text, and non-message events with neither payload. Cardinality counts payload presence, not byte or string inhabitants.
